jobs.occupation: Junior Researcher on Multi-Agent Collaboration for Autonomous Ground Systems (iMUGS2) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT

You work within the Robotics & Autonomous Systems (https://mecatron.rma.ac.be/) research unit of the department of Mechanics of the Polytechnic Faculty of the RMA. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled ¿iMUGS2¿.Your research will focus on the application of Multi-Agent Collaboration technology for collaborative autonomy in unmanned ground systems, including:

• Develop an interoperable, open, and modular multi-agent architecture in the global architecture of the project's System-of-Systems
• Study and integration of optimal multi-robot planning algorithms
• Define communication interface to enable the exchange of information between the team
 

Given the applied nature of this project and its strong involvement in European-scale collaborative defence programs, you will occasionally prepare and participate in on-site demonstrations and field trials, mainly on military sites in Europe.

 

MAIN TASKS

• Research/prototype multi-agent collaborative autonomy solutions for unmanned ground systems.
• Support development and implementation of standards that enable interoperability, focusing on mission management and multi-agent autonomy.
• Contribute to the integration with ROS/ROS2 of the developed solutions in real vehicles.
• Participate in testing, validation, and demonstration campaigns.
• Document your research and contribute to scientific publications, deliverables, and project reports. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree(s) required / ideal degree(s): Master/Engineer's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or related fields

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) or experienced profiles (up to 10 years of experience.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Excellent oral & written knowledge of English
• Experience in Robotics and knowledge in ROS/ROS2
• 
Good programming skills in Python and/or C++

 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills: 

• Experience in Multi-Agent Collaboration, or multimodal AI
• Knowledge in simulation environments for robotics
• Knowledge in robotics and/or software architecture design
• Knowledge in interoperability, standardisation and/or, more specifically, NATO STANAG/STANREC standards
• Experience in organising tests and demonstrations
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
Personal skills:

• Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary, international team
• You will be working closely together with multiple industrial and academic partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must.
• You are comfortable working in a complex international, multi-partner environment, fostering constructive collaboration, and resolving interpersonal tensions when needed.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European or NATO projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From 15 November 2026, in consultation with the applicant. 
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours/week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding project, which is guaranteed until November 2028 (end of iMUGS2 project). There is a high chance for the project to be prolonged after this initial period, depending on the availability of new funding. 
• Wage scale: class NA11 (holder of a Master's degree in Science or equivalent), or NA21 (holder of an Ir degree or equivalent Master's in Engineering Sciences, doctor's degree in the same area of expertise), with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• 
Holiday pay.

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) & 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach
